title: .saasaloy/manifest.json, version 2 — the render engine's file records
description: Records each file the render engine wrote: the module and source path it came from, its class, the sha256 of the raw render (before Prettier), and the release that wrote that render (plan 0116). A version 1 manifest has no `version` key and validates against manifest.schema.json instead. Unknown fields are refused, so a CLI that reads only version 1 refuses this file.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor validation.

files.description: Project-relative POSIX path → the record of the render that wrote it.

module.description: The module whose file this is, or `base` for a template file.

from.description: Module-relative source path (`files/src/x.ts`), or template-relative for `base`.

class.description: `generated`: written in full on every run. `merged`: a three-way merge on each run. `once`: written when the path is new, then left alone.

hash.description: sha256 of the raw render, before Prettier, never of the bytes on disk. The engine accepts a render as the base of a merge only when its hash equals this value.

version.description: The release that wrote this render. For a `once` file it stays at the release that wrote it, so the base of a later `update --merge` is findable.

pendingMerges.description: Files a run left with conflict markers. A run reads only these files to look for markers, clears an entry once no marker line remains, and refuses while any entry stays.

pendingNotes.description: Update notes shown and not yet cleared with `saasaloy update --done <id>` (ADR 0058), in the order they were first shown.

doneNotes.description: Update note ids `saasaloy update --done <id>` cleared, sorted, once each.
